meta_description: Martin's Painting & Decorating in Nottingham. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decoration services. Free quotes. Call 07494 123228.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior painting. From feature walls to full room makeovers, we deliver professional results on time, every time.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services in Nottingham
services_subhead: Whether you need a fresh coat of paint, wallpapering, or a complete room transformation, we handle every project with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Refresh your living spaces with high-quality interior paint. We prep, prime, and paint walls and ceilings to a professional finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Protect and enhance your home's exterior. We paint fascias, soffits, doors, and weathered walls using weather-resistant finishes.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Create impact with a striking feature wall or bold accent colour. We help you choose the right shade and execute it flawlessly.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging for any room. We handle pattern matching, corner work, and tricky ceiling applications with expertise.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, and fitted furniture deserve expert attention. We sand, prime, and paint to a smooth, durable finish.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Repairs
services.desc: Proper prep is everything. We fill cracks, sand surfaces, and make good any damage before painting—ensuring a flawless result.

about_pullquote: Good decorating starts with care, not shortcuts.
about_para_1: Martin's Painting & Decorating was founded on a simple idea: that skilled, honest work at a fair price should be the norm, not the exception. Over 15 years, we've built our reputation one home at a time, decorating hundreds of properties across Nottingham and the surrounding areas. We take pride in showing up on time, treating your home with respect, and leaving it spotless.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen to what you want, give you a clear quote with no surprises, and finish jobs to a standard we'd be happy with in our own homes. Whether you need a quick refresh or a full transformation, you'll work directly with experienced decorators who care about getting it right.

reviews.text: Martin came to do two bedrooms and the hallway. He was punctual, tidy, and got the whole job done in five days. The finish is brilliant—looks like a professional has been in. Quoted us £950 and that's exactly what we paid. No hidden costs. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: We wanted a feature wall in our living room and weren't sure what colour would work. Martin gave us honest advice, showed us samples, and nailed it. Very friendly bloke, cleaned up after himself every day. Will definitely have him back when we redecorate the kitchen.
reviews.author: Emma R.

reviews.text: Had our whole house painted inside—walls, woodwork, the lot. Three-week job and he stuck to his timeline. The quality is exceptional. Worth every penny. Would trust him with any future decorating work.
reviews.author: Michael K.
